prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset: a SINGLE tight dialogue portrait for a grounded dark fantasy pixel-art RPG, intended working grid 74 pixels wide by 100 high.
Input 1 is Qiduo's approved REVISED identity master, for identity only, NOT its full-body composition or fine rendering. Inputs 2–5 are Mara, Iwo, Leiya and Tore, STRICT style/composition references only. Do not copy another man's face.
SUBJECT: Qiduo, a man in his THIRTIES, injured miner and Aiqin's adult older brother. Preserve the revised identity's broad round cheeks, short blunt wide nose, thin fairly horizontal eyebrows, heavy tired under-eye bags, small uneven sparse moustache/chin stubble and dark warm eyes. His hair is short and coarse, with irregular blunt fringe. LATEST CARD UPDATE: mineral dust coats the short hair gray-brown, visibly dusty desaturated gray over a brown base, NOT elderly white hair. Mature adult around 36–39, not elderly, not a youthful pretty boy. Preserve the gray-brown work tunic and small low tied notch neckline. Thick shoulder-pad fabric may appear only as a tiny outer collar sliver.
Expression: physically tired but self-possessed and clear about his choices. Slight leftward gaze and closed lips with restrained firm neutrality. Relatively level thin brow; avoid exaggerated arched inner brows and the generic tragic or angry scowl. No new face wound, blood, heroic smile or implication of recovery.
COMPOSITION: 74:100 upright portrait proportion. Large face, short neck and a very narrow collar at bottom. Complete hair crown, both side hair silhouettes and visible ear; never cut or touch canvas edges. Keep at least 2 logical pixels of genuine transparent margin at top and sides, with a little bottom clearance. No bust, chest, broad shoulders, stool, legs, hands, wrist brace, lamp, props, text or background. Those out-of-frame body details are deliberately omitted, not removed from his character.
STYLE: coarse hard-edged pixel clusters matching reference portraits 2–5, sculpted large contiguous nose/cheek/jaw planes at a 74x100 logical grid, not fine illustration. Restrained earthy 24–32 colors. Eyes small and dark, only one muted warm-gray hint of sclera at most, no bright white stripes. Dusty hair in 4–6 blocky masses with a few broad muted-gray accents, not many parallel spikes. Sparse stubble as a few connected shadow masses around chin and upper lip, NO noisy individual dots or full thick beard. Under-eye bags as broad subtle blocks. Crisp outline and flat collar planes; no gradients, dithering, stipple, painterly softness, antialias halo or micro-texture.
Backdrop: genuinely transparent RGBA with hard binary-alpha outline, no checkerboard painting. This must be a substantive imagegen portrait redraw, never a crop or scaled copy of the full-body master.
